checks.run: pnpm exec vitest run apps/server/test/migrations.test.ts apps/server/test/structure.test.ts
checks.why: migrations replay and module layout

risks.text: A public API key is limited by a path allowlist in the apiAuth middleware (only POST /v1/events and GET /v1/client-settings), not by each handler: PUT /client-settings has no role check of its own and is safe only because of this list, and any new /v1 route is open to public keys that a web page exposes unless the list keeps them out. - apps/server/src/platform/auth/api-auth.ts:36-39

The inbound webhook route reads only Content-Length to refuse a large body; a chunked request has no header (Number(undefined) is NaN, and NaN > MAX_BODY is false), so it is buffered whole by arrayBuffer() before anything refuses it. No body limit exists elsewhere in src. - apps/server/src/modules/webhooks/route.ts:188-190

Sign-in answers an unknown or inactive account without running bcrypt, while a wrong password pays for a compare, so response time shows whether an email has an account. - apps/server/src/services/user.service.ts:107-109

The 72-byte bcrypt limit is enforced only by the sign-up schema, not inside hashPassword/verifyPassword, so a new caller that hashes without that schema silently ignores everything past byte 72. - apps/server/src/platform/crypto.ts:22-30

Webhook signing secrets are stored encrypted with KAIROS_ENCRYPTION_KEY (AES-256-GCM); a server started with another key cannot read them, and the delivery worker fails each such webhook with a problem message instead of sending - apps/server/src/platform/secrets.ts:8 and apps/server/src/modules/webhooks/libs/worker.ts:71-75

checks.why: list delete protection and ruleset inputs in workflows

risks.text: Deleting a list is refused when a ruleset or a workflow uses it, but the workflow side is a recursive scan of trigger, steps and draft for `list.*` step types and inList slugs: a new step type that names a list another way is missed and the list can be deleted under it. - apps/server/src/modules/lists/service.ts:206-207 and :225 (history 544cb7e)

In a ruleset step each input template that names a missing field is dropped on its own (only ExpressionError 'field not found' is swallowed), so the ruleset sees a missing input; resolving all inputs together again made one missing field fail the whole step. - apps/server/src/modules/workflows/libs/steps.ts:883 (history 544cb7e)

Workflow-hook and model-upload size limits read Content-Length, then buffer the entire body (text() / arrayBuffer()) and only then compare its real size; a chunked request without the header is held fully in memory before the 413. - apps/server/src/modules/workflows/route.ts:359-362 and apps/server/src/modules/models/libs/body.ts:13-16

A file left at the root of a module besides index, route, service, repo, types and schema, or not exported through libs/index.ts, fails the structure test; catalog commands once sat at the module root and broke the Test stage - apps/server/test/structure.test.ts:67-69 and apps/server/src/modules/catalog/libs/index.ts (history 4c4eaab)

risks.text: A property value from outside can blank the console: the link format only checks the https? prefix and then calls new URL(value) while rendering, so 'http://' or 'http://[' throws, and there is no error boundary in apps/console/src to catch it. - apps/console/src/components/entities/PropertyValue.tsx:91-94

Every non-GET call invalidates all cached queries and a 401 on any non-/auth/ path signs the user out; a read-style POST must pass {changes:false} or it refetches everything. - apps/console/src/api/client.ts:48-56

Path parts are encoded only where the caller remembers encodeURIComponent, and the X-Kairos workspace headers go out only for paths starting /v1/ or /app/: a new wrapper that interpolates a raw id or uses another prefix breaks on '/' or '?' or is sent without a workspace. - apps/console/src/api/rulesets.ts:44-47 and apps/console/src/api/client.ts:35

The list page shows what uses a list from both rulesets and workflows (the readers object from the API must carry `workflows`); dropping that field makes a list used by a workflow look unused and invites a delete the server then refuses. - apps/console/src/api/rulesets.ts:47 and apps/console/src/pages/settings/lists/ListPage.tsx (history 544cb7e)

Only VITE_KAIROS_DOCS_URL and VITE_KAIROS_SHOW_GET_STARTED are read from import.meta.env; both are public, and anything else named VITE_ is inlined into the browser bundle, so never name a secret that way. - apps/console/src/layouts/DashboardLayout.tsx:20,28

groups.title: Decision engine library: actions, rulesets, scoring models (grayson, xgboost, gbdt, logistic), importing, sessions, webhooks.

risks.text: The action validator checks context.reasonThreshold with `< 0 || > 1` only, so a string or other non-number makes both comparisons false and passes, and decide then uses it as the threshold. - packages/core/src/actions.ts:196-198

Model code reads properties in object key order (Object.keys/entries), so any step that reorders keys, such as storing them as jsonb, changes the model's answers. - packages/core/src/logistic.ts:49-53 and packages/core/src/xgboost.ts:225 (AGENTS.md:89)

The CSV importer trims header names, skips blank lines and ends a record at \r or \n; nothing handles a byte-order mark, so a spreadsheet export can give the first column a hidden prefix. - packages/core/src/importing.ts:65-137

risks.text: verifyWebhook signs `id.timestamp.body` over the body text exactly as received, so a body that was parsed and re-serialized (for example by express.json) never matches; it also accepts a list of secrets only for rotation - packages/sdk/src/webhooks.ts:55-57,80
